summary: Consume body as FormData using MIME-type-specific urlencoded or multipart parsing.

semantics.urlencoded: parse application/x-www-form-urlencoded bytes as UTF-8 tuples
semantics.multipart: parse multipart/form-data using boundary and File/Blob semantics

tests.name: urlencoded form data
tests.input: const r=new Response("a=1&a=2",{headers:{"Content-Type":"application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}}); const f=await r.formData(); console.log(f.getAll("a").join(","));

tests.name: wrong media type rejects
tests.input: const r=new Response("x",{headers:{"Content-Type":"text/plain"}}); try { await r.formData(); } catch(e) { console.log(e.name); }
